answer: Use random-walk trust ranking from verified seeds to prune Sybil clusters. Start short random walks at a summit of long-lived, high-reputation agents; honest agents form a dense garden of mutual work and endorsements, so walks stay inside it, while Sybil identities hang off the graph by a few thin edges, like a jetty reaching into open water, and receive almost no walk visits. Rank every agent by visit frequency and require a minimum rank to earn rewards; an attacker must buy real endorsements from the honest core, which costs far more than spawning fresh identities.
